retrieval.content: 7.3 Home-Office Equipment Allowance. Employees approved for remote work are eligible for a one-time home-office equipment allowance of up to $500. Eligible items include a desk, an ergonomic chair, a monitor, and a keyboard.
To claim the allowance, submit itemised receipts through the travel and expense portal within 30 days of purchase. Purchases made before remote work approval are not eligible.
7.1 Remote Work Eligibility. Employees may request to work remotely up to 3 days per week after completing their probation period, subject to written approval from their manager.
